Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage

Interface StorageProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
MysqlStorageProvider, YamlStorageProvider
public interface StorageProvider
Abstraction for storage backends (YML files, MySQL, SQLite, etc.). Implementations provide simple key-based load/save/delete semantics where the framework and repositories map domain IDs to storage paths.

The init(Object) parameter is typed as Object so this interface can be implemented for any server platform without a platform dependency in the API module. Implementations should cast to their expected platform plugin type (e.g. JavaPlugin, PluginContainer).
